breakglass.form.invalid: The username or password is not correct. Check them and try again.
breakglass.form.retryIn: You can try again in {seconds} s.
breakglass.form.title: Break-glass access
breakglass.form.warning: For emergencies only. This account does not use Microsoft sign-in or multi-factor authentication, and every attempt is recorded in the audit log. With it you can only restore the Owner. The session ends after {minutes} minutes.
breakglass.restore.disabled: This account is disabled. Enable the account in Microsoft Entra first, or choose another person.
breakglass.restore.done: The Owner role was restored. Sign out of break-glass access and sign in with the account of that person.
breakglass.restore.fieldHelp: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the person, in the form 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. The panel checks that the account exists and is enabled.
breakglass.restore.lead: Give the Owner role back to a person, so that they can manage access again. This is the only thing a break-glass session can change.
breakglass.restore.title: Restore the Owner
breakglass.restore.unverified.message: The panel could not check that this user exists and is enabled. If you are sure the ID is correct, you can restore the Owner without that check. The audit log records that it was not checked.
breakglass.restore.unverified.title: Microsoft could not be reached
